notes.title: August update and the new road map.
notes.content:
Hello to all!

I hope this month of August has been good for you. This week comes the monthly update.

Before listing the additions of this month, I want to inform you about the changes of the road map until the end of the year. Indeed, the sales of the game do not allow me to continue the development full time. My time allocated to Hell of Men is therefore reduced and the programmed content impacted.

The new road map is as follows:
[u]August:[/u]
[list]
[*] Various bug fixes.
[*] Addition of a new map "Frost" created by the team that was in charge of improving the maps at the beginning of the year. I thought it was important to give them the opportunity to create their own map. Frost offers a vehicle-free map with a maze of small wooden bridges.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35509637/fec409e5c5888776c1e827ad89d1093db70cb563.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35509637/ee70c0948b3161e67228dae15fb2f9aee6eda7fa.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35509637/c4f873f382ff9fd095475bf43f0d5dfa91a63e59.png[/img]
[*] Added a new look for France: "Grand Bleu". Created by Fanny who did an internship at Whacky Squad Studio at the beginning of the summer.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35509637/e676d6986c3cb281c1479ccb87e368519d50dbcc.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35509637/c6deb35095c9113f64bb4726f7444cae5a1856ab.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35509637/3bf69820e9847099232a4401465eab50c066878b.png[/img]
[*] Added the following languages: Italian, Polish, Russian. If you see any errors, please send them up for correction.
[/list]

[u]September:[/u]
[list]
[*] Adding a new map and a new gameplay element, more details later this month.
[/list]

[u]October:[/u]
[list]
[*] Added a new map.
[/list]

[u]November:[/u]
[list]
[*] Added a new map.
[/list]

[u]December:[/u]
[list]
[*] Added a new look.

The rest of the story is no longer scheduled for this end of the year. This road map represents the minimum. It is possible that it will evolve according to the time I can free for Hell of Men.

I thank you for your messages and kind reviews.

Concerning the multiplayer, I know that there are problems of synchronization of the players. I don't have a solution for the moment. I am looking for the problem to solve it quickly.

Good game to all !

notes.title: Release: The New Maps
notes.content:
Hello and welcome to this new article. Today, we are going to present you the 4 new maps.  

[u][b]Noviny :[/b][/u]
[list]
[*] Number of players: 2.
[*] Size: 150x150.
[*] Number of strategic points: 3.
[*] Type of vehicles: Jeep, Buggy, Truck, Armoured Support.
[/list]
After the defeat of the Russians in the north of the country, a Russian armoured column breaks through the Lithuanian lines in a small farm.  
Playable in 2 players, Noviny offers a colourful map, with farm facilities in the centre surrounded by green pastures and wooded areas offering plenty of cover.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35509637/402425fb42891c5d35845554d0bc22a97e0a73c2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35509637/2d3a51b1d80f29acd17ba8cbaccf54605f6a2250.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35509637/8e4bb6c06274299d80a8f8787d55a6ed4c4c43b5.png[/img]

[u]Mishkawka :[/u]
[list]
[*] Number of players: 4.  
[*] Size: 170x170.  
[*] Number of strategic points: 5.  
[*] Type of vehicles: Jeep, Armoured Support, Light Tank, Tank.  
[/list]
Mishkawka is the last stand of the Russian tanks which inflicted heavy losses on the French troops. Entrenched in a small group of houses in the countryside. They decided to make a front to allow the Russian army to reach the border.  

Mishkawka offers a large no man's land in the centre of the map, in its centre, the strategic point which will give access to the battle tank. Lined with trees and houses with lots of cover. Mishkawka offers interesting possibilities for larger battles.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35509637/8119378512f376ead2964c47bf6c45f6e867b593.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35509637/82a4fa64cc8b81fd4c9aebd5c2a603c3149fe1c9.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35509637/6f59d1ea9a1063069fa31cda2c31105fe7815c98.png[/img]

[u]Pahost :[/u]
[list]
[*] Number of players: 4.  
[*] Size: 120x200.  
[*] Number of strategic points: 5.  
[*] Type of vehicles: Jeep, Buggy, Armoured Transport, Light Tank.  
[/list]
Pahost is the location of the first encounter between the French and the Russian armoured column. The Russians arrive by surprise at the rear of the French lines and silence them, thus relieving the pressure on the Russian defences.  

Pahost is cut lengthways by the highway and widthways by a supermarket and a network of silos. Pahost offers a rich vehicle combat and many shortcuts for the infantry with a play on the heights offering beautiful strategic perspectives.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35509637/06f2224ff4d78c9dc2fa3bf4d84201439d9b53d0.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35509637/8faabaec4ed5c44f3f3987cf59be3006b08d0683.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35509637/75b88be1ece3fbce795f223215817a388f0c1586.png[/img]

[u]Naliboki Forest :[/u]
[list]
[*] Number of players: 4.  
[*] Size: 170x170.  
[*] Number of strategic points: 5.  
[*] Type of vehicles : Jeep, Armoured Transport, Tank.  
[/list]
After a helicopter crash in the Belarusian mountains, rescue searches is remotely commanded by a promising new officer. A Russian commando is assigned to eliminate him.  

Naliboki Forest, named after the place that inspires it, is set in the large protected forest of Naliboki in Belarus. A vast space where a great diversity of animals and plants live. Naliboki Forest is symmetrical for all 4 players and requires a passage through the centre. Battles will rage for the control of the centre of the map, as there you will find interesting vehicles and resources. 
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35509637/31851ecb63ba6e4942ef553545a336c143faa7d5.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35509637/e20633eb24bb6883d5a6e7670a05fdf1070376f2.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35509637/d3d80d6e689321df90011217179cdc0880f826c2.png[/img]

These new maps are available in both the NATO and UK campaigns, as well as in skirmish mode.

notes.title: Hell of Men: Blood Brothers - New factions!
notes.content:
Hello to all,  

Today, you will discover in this article, the new faction that will be available in v1.  The Baltic Countries are coming in Hell of Men: Blood Brothers! 
The Baltic Countries are represented by 3 skins in the game. Latvia, Lithuania and Estonia. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35509637/4630a5d1170237b4502e4a83035730ca4609eb16.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35509637/340d992c4a52b3284b2fc0e2579599b5b803f9b3.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35509637/4e38f8ae854f95e9249f124932b3197cbc044c5a.png[/img]

[u][b]Building:[/b][/u]
The buildings have a "container" style, we find the same as for the other factions except for the infirmary which disappears.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35509637/62bd125ede5892b77a665a2c1cd8d04b0cc42591.png[/img]

The specificity of the tent is its low cost which can give an advantage at the beginning of the game, however it offers only 3 additional population slots. You will have to build more tents than the other factions to reach the maximum of 40 units.  

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35509637/8a7b2ed6926d01a888698d3305a1481fa6a90e0d.png[/img]

[u][b]Unit:[/b][/u]
[u]Barracks:[/u] 
[list]
[*] Rifleman = Germany/Russia.  
[*] Grenade launcher = all factions.  
[*] Rocket launcher = Poland/Russia.  
[*] Fusion launcher = all factions.  
[*] Operator = Poland/Belarus.  
[*] Machine gunner/Mastodon = + 1 damage / 0.1 rate of fire reduction.  
[*] Sniper/Sniper guillie = - 5 damage / increase rate of fire by +2.  
[/list]

[u]Communication Center:[/u]
[list]
[*] Sapper = Russia - short range.  
[*] Tank crew = Poland/Russia/Belarus.  
[*] Mortar = - 1 damage / increase movement speed by +0.3. 
[/list]

[u]Laboratory:[/u]
[list]
[*] UAV = all factions.  
[*] New Unit : Anti-infantry combat drone.  
[*] New Unit : Anti-tank combat drone.  
[*] New Unit : Healing Drone.  
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35509637/af5cd58a9dc3bf64e5e048ab23f866e6fee12f21.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35509637/019fc0b235d69e476159dc278b8e04fa41cf1b02.png[/img]

The anti-infantry combat drone is inspired by the Estonian Milsem drone with its anti-vehicle variant. It has the same attack stats as the Russian drone with a higher hit point count and reduced speed. Its anti-tank variant joins the French anti-tank drone but uses rockets.  

The healing drone is a flying drone with the ability to heal infantry units.  
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35509637/16eb4b90e466eb160bdd1b08bcbd9c863b5094f0.png[/img]
 

[u]Vehicle:[/u]  
The Buggy is equal to the other factions with only 3 seats.  
The Jeep is equipped with a grenade launcher and reduced armor –20 health points.  
The Truck is equal to the German faction and unarmed.  
The Armored Support is equal to that of the Polish faction.  
The Light Tank is equal to that of the Polish faction with reinforced armor giving it +50 health points.  
The Tank is equal to the other factions with a reinforced armor giving it +50 health points. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35509637/25cc80b355912943fde0a799a5cd71872f49d713.png[/img]

Hi!  

We are pleased to announce that Zerouno Games, Publisher of PC and console video games, will join the French studio Wacky Squad Studio in the launch of the strategy game Hell of Men: Blood Brothers. 

[img]https://db3pap005files.storage.live.com/y4mzCOyHAxrdj5xVenbm9PSEApgUSbgGApSDC5MkPRIaEytTsxG3eK2ZY6lyaK-aIs4nBx_6zSAjkfmF90VdjunoeTJFn27xMNGzXW8UeNAIyysc3Sey5-gv6Nx1y0UrGaIpQEjoOaMLjfxD2He33oNPA1oxwsoryj77nKdOfjIDxoq1D0shuih6yOAl711vtbC?width=800&height=450&cropmode=none[/img]

Hello everyone,

[u]Faction:[/u]

-Arrival of the France and Belarus sub-factions. These are sub-factions because I didn't want them to be exclusively new skins. You find all the characteristics of the mother factions with some modifications.

[u]-France:[/u] France is a sub-faction of Germany with a more powerful rifleman and a UAV seeing further. On the other hand, the technician's life bonus is not present and armoured transport is lower (lower damage, lower health, slight speed bonus).

[u]-Belarus:[/u] Belarus is a sub-faction of Poland with a sapper who builds defenses faster, a very efficient armoured transport! Hello everyone,

Discover the new additions and modifications in this update 17.

[u]Mechanics:[/u]
-Addition of an Age system (3 ages).
[url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35509637/717e36cc507d9f9c6a6715c66955ba12026188af.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35509637/e9a3d5fd47cec490ce6629d84a70beb92f347f9d.png[/img][/url][url={STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35509637/4f906f2b46b6ddaf4c8f75b95a2696904cae40ad.png][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35509637/691b4a7844d1f2a60b5aae14add0db40fb068e6b.png[/img][/url]
-Reorganization of units and buildings.
Military units have been reorganized. The barracks offers 4 types of soldiers (Rifleman, Machine Gunner, Grenade Launcher, Sniper).
The Com-Center offers 2 types of soldiers (Tank Crew, Sapper).
Age 1 is equivalent to "patrol" clashes, Age 2 offers you the possibility to drive tanks, fortify your positions and update a part of your units, it's equivalent to a "moderate engagement". Age 3 allows the arrival of special forces and drones, which is equivalent to "full engagement".

[u]Age 1: [/u]
-Barrack (Rifle, Machine Gunner, Grenade Launcher)
-Laboratory (UAV)
-Generator
-Tent
-Container
-Cantina

[u]Age 2: [/u]
-Barrack (Sniper unlocking)
-Com-Center (Tank crew, Sapper)
-Infirmary (Medic)
-Armoury (Machine Gunner Upgrade, Grenade Launcher Upgrade)

[u]Age 3: [/u]
-HQ
-Laboratory (Collection Drone unlocking / Combat Drone unlocking)
-Armory (Rifleman Upgrade unlocking, Sniper Upgrade unlocking)

-Review of unit costs. Unit costs are now defined by their statistics to have consistent costs.
Food cost: 20 + number of life points.
Ammo cost: 20 + Damage per second to buildings + Damage per second to units.
Material cost: Speed*10 + Skill.
Skill : 
+ 0 Short Range.
+ 5 Medium Range.
+ 10 Long Range.
+ 5 Ability to capture a strategic point.
+ 10 Guilli.

-Review of unit recruiting times.
-Updated the Nav Mesh which now takes into account debris in heavy cover.
-Add explosion sounds to the "Effect" module in the settings menu.

notes.title: Update 12
notes.content:
Hello,

Update 12 is coming for tomorrow!
I suggest you to start this news with the bad news and finish with the good ones.

[u]Multiplayers:[/u]
As you can see, multiplayer is still not available. We are working on it but the problem is more complicated than we thought. I'm not going to give you a date to tell you for the 4th time that the deadline is not met. I will keep you informed of the progress and I hope to propose it to you soon. Once this connection problem is solved everything will be fine. Indeed, the maps and factions are finished and ready.

[u]Cooperation: [/u]
In addition to the same problem as multiplayers, there is an additional difficulty. The game didn't take into account the cooperation mode from the beginning of development. As a result, it is necessary to recode a part of the game. Unfortunately I don't have the resources to do it at the moment. So version 1.0 will not include a cooperation mode. I would still like to add a cooperation mode but I can't tell you whether or not a cooperation mode will be released for Hell of Men Blood Brothers.

Let's go to the good news!

[u]Story: [/u]
Story mode is 95% complete. Now I need to test all missions and fix the few bugs that are still present. I plan to do it early next week to propose you the story mode in next Friday's update. This is my Goal!
Voices!  In a previous news I informed you that there will be no voice-over. I'm going back on that because I had a proposal this week that allows me to do it. So yes there will be voices for the narration sequences at the beginning of each mission. However, you have to give the artist time to record the sounds. They won't be available when the story mode is released but should arrive soon.

[u]The Save & Load system:[/u]
I've started looking into how to integrate a system for saving and loading your games. I wanted to release it for February but the story mode took me longer than expected.

[u]Mechanical: [/u]
-Add faction color item to all infantry units.

Sapper / Sniper / Special Force / Jeep.

notes.title: Preview of Update 06
notes.content:
Hello,

There will be no update this Friday. I'm working on several things at the same time to give you a big update next week.

To begin, I reviewed the Road Map:

[u]November :[/u]

-I have reduced the number of maps and skirmishes to have more time to work on the Story mode. Skirmishes are still planned but will be added later.
-The arrival of the new map: [b]Airport[/b].
This Autumn themed map offers a different approach. In the middle is the airport with a large runway that offers no cover. You will also find on each side forest areas that do not allow vehicles to pass, only the infantry will be able to access these positions.
Be careful, you will find Belarusian soldiers there who will defend the airport against all players.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35509637/5dc7de5a72783cb078fec83d337e622054b7e570.png[/img]
